add-highlight-annotation-70-opacity.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a highlight annotation, set its color and 70% opacity, add it to a page, and save the updated document.

add-sound-annotation-voiceover-page-five.title: Add Sound Annotation to PDF Page
add-sound-annotation-voiceover-page-five.description: Demonstrates adding a SoundAnnotation that plays a voice‑over when the user clicks a defined rectangle on page five of a PDF document.

add-qr-code-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add QR Code Watermark to PDF
add-qr-code-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a WatermarkArtifact, and embed a QR code image positioned at the top‑right corner of the page using Aspose.Pdf.

create-button-toggle-annotations-visibil.title: Create Toggle Annotations Button in PDF
create-button-toggle-annotations-visibil.description: Shows how to add a button form field with JavaScript that toggles the visibility of all annotations on the current page of a PDF.

batch-add-sound-annotations-to-pdf-pages.title: Batch Add Sound Annotations to PDF Pages
batch-add-sound-annotations-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add a different sound annotation to each page of a PDF by loading audio files, creating SoundAnnotation objects, and saving the updated document.

extract-media-from-screenannotation.title: Extract Embedded Media from Screen Annotations
extract-media-from-screenannotation.description: The example opens a PDF, scans each page for ScreenAnnotation objects, retrieves any embedded RichMedia content via reflection, and saves the media files to disk for further analysis.

add-read-only-rich-media-pdf-annotation.title: Add Read‑Only Rich Media PDF Annotation
add-read-only-rich-media-pdf-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to embed an external PDF as a Rich Media annotation in another PDF and configure it for read‑only, auto‑play view using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-annotations-to-csv.title: Export PDF Annotations to CSV for Auditing
export-pdf-annotations-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through every annotation on each page, extracts key details (type, rectangle coordinates, title, contents) and writes them to a CSV file for audit purposes.

add-button-annotation-highlight-text-fie.title: Add Button to Highlight Text Fields via JavaScript
add-button-annotation-highlight-text-fie.description: Shows how to insert a button form field into a PDF that executes JavaScript to highlight all text fields on the current page.

set-link-annotation-border-red-width-3.title: Set Link Annotation Border Color to Red and Width to 3 Points
set-link-annotation-border-red-width-3.description: Shows how to change the border colour of every link annotation in a PDF to red and increase its line width to three points using Aspose.Pdf.

add-repeating-text-watermark-artifact.title: Add Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-repeating-text-watermark-artifact.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a semi‑transparent diagonal text stamp, adds it to every page, and saves the watermarked document.

add-screen-annotation-swf-readonly.title: Add Screen Annotation with External SWF and Read‑Only Flag
add-screen-annotation-swf-readonly.description: Demonstrates how to add a ScreenAnnotation that references an external SWF file to a PDF page and set it to read‑only to prevent user editing.

batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.title: Batch Import XFDF Annotations into PDFs
batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, import matching XFDF annotation files, merge the annotations into each PDF, and save the annotated documents to an output directory.

replace-pdf-page-background-images.title: Replace Background Artifacts with New Images in PDF
replace-pdf-page-background-images.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through each page, removes existing BackgroundArtifact objects, and inserts a new ImageStamp with the same position and size, then saves the modified document.

metadata-watermark-annotation.title: Add Dynamic Barcode Watermark to PDF Pages
metadata-watermark-annotation.description: Loads a PDF, creates a barcode‑like image from the document's title and author using System.Drawing, and applies it as a semi‑transparent watermark on every page with an ImageStamp.

add-javascript-link-annotation-modal-dia.title: Add JavaScript Link Annotation to Show Modal Dialog
add-javascript-link-annotation-modal-dia.description: Demonstrates how to create a link annotation with a JavaScript action that displays a custom modal dialog box in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-watermark-dynamic-opacity.title: Batch Watermark PDFs with Dynamic Opacity
batch-watermark-dynamic-opacity.description: Loads each PDF in a folder, computes an opacity based on the document's page count, and applies a centered "CONFIDENTIAL" text stamp as a watermark to every page before saving the result.

create-3d-annotation-metallic-lighting.title: Create 3D Metal Surface Annotation in PDF
create-3d-annotation-metallic-lighting.description: Demonstrates how to embed a U3D model in a PDF as a 3D annotation with custom lighting and render settings that simulate a realistic metallic surface.

add-sound-annotation-chime.title: Add Sound Annotation (Chime) to PDF Page
add-sound-annotation-chime.description: Shows how to insert a SoundAnnotation that plays a chime when the user scrolls to a specific page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

clone-richmedia-annotations-summary-page.title: Clone Rich Media Annotations to Summary Page
clone-richmedia-annotations-summary-page.description: Shows how to programmatically clone every RichMediaAnnotation in a PDF and place the clones on a newly added summary page.

create-pdf-button-export-annotations-jso.title: Add Button to Export Annotations as JSON
create-pdf-button-export-annotations-jso.description: Shows how to insert a button form field into a PDF that runs JavaScript to collect all page annotations and display them as a JSON string.

extract-embedded-rich-media.title: Extract Embedded Media from Rich Media Annotations
extract-embedded-rich-media.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through its pages and RichMedia annotations, and extracts all embedded media assets (audio, video, images, etc.) into a structured folder hierarchy.

create-link-annotation-remote-pdf-page.title: Add Remote Link Annotation to Open a Page in Another PDF
create-link-annotation-remote-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to create a link annotation that opens a specific page of an external PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-animated-gif-screen-annotation.title: Add Looping Animated GIF as Screen Annotation on PDF Page
add-animated-gif-screen-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to add a RichMedia (Screen) annotation containing an animated GIF to page three of a PDF and configure it to play automatically and loop continuously using Aspose.Pdf.

align-watermark-annotations-to-page-marg.title: Align Watermark Annotations to Page Margins
align-watermark-annotations-to-page-marg.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages, locate WatermarkAnnotation objects, and reset their rectangle so they fit uniformly within a specified margin on each page.

toggle-rich-media-annotation-visibility.title: Toggle Rich Media Annotation Visibility with a Button
toggle-rich-media-annotation-visibility.description: Demonstrates adding a RichMediaAnnotation to a PDF and a button field that runs JavaScript to toggle the annotation's hidden state on click.

add-3d-annotation-front-view.title: Add 3D Annotation with Embedded U3D and Front‑View Rotation
add-3d-annotation-front-view.description: Demonstrates how to embed a U3D model into a PDF as a 3D annotation, set its initial rotation to show the front face, and optionally style the annotation background using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-replace-watermark-annotations.title: Batch Replace Watermark Annotations with Current Date
batch-replace-watermark-annotations.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages and annotations, and replaces every WatermarkAnnotation with a new text that includes the current date, applying a custom TextState.

add-word-count-link-annotation.title: Create Link Annotation to Show Document Word Count
add-word-count-link-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to add a link annotation with a JavaScript action that calculates and displays the total word count of a PDF document.

add-automatic-background-music-to-pdf.title: Add Auto-Playing Background Music with SoundAnnotation
add-automatic-background-music-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a SoundAnnotation in a PDF that automatically plays background music when the page becomes visible, using reflection to stay compatible with different Aspose.Pdf versions.

create-pdf-gradient-background-artifact.title: Create PDF with Gradient Background Using Graph
create-pdf-gradient-background-artifact.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF and add a simulated linear gradient as a page background by drawing many thin rectangles inside a Graph object.

add-dynamic-page-number-watermark.title: Create Dynamic Page Number Watermark Annotation
add-dynamic-page-number-watermark.description: Shows how to add a WatermarkAnnotation with page‑number placeholders that automatically update on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rich-media-annotation-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Rich Media Annotation with PDF Portfolio and Initial View
add-rich-media-annotation-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF portfolio into a RichMediaAnnotation and configure the annotation to open the first file when the page is opened using Aspose.Pdf.

change-button-annotation-color-to-blue.title: Set Button Annotation Color to Blue
change-button-annotation-color-to-blue.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all annotations in a PDF, identify button fields, change their border color to blue, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiline-freetext-annotation-line-s.title: Add Multiline Free‑Text Annotation with Line Spacing
add-multiline-freetext-annotation-line-s.description: The example loads a PDF, creates a free‑text annotation containing multiple lines, sets its background color, border, and uses rich‑text HTML to apply a line spacing of 1.5 before saving the document.

add-free-text-annotation-light-gray.title: Add Free‑Text Annotation with Light Gray Background
add-free-text-annotation-light-gray.description: Shows how to insert a free‑text annotation on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, set its background to light gray, and configure a simple border.

javascript-sum-button-form-fields.title: Create JavaScript Button to Sum Form Fields
javascript-sum-button-form-fields.description: Shows how to add two numeric text boxes, a read‑only result field, and a button with a JavaScript action that calculates and displays the sum of the two fields in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-streaming-rich-media-video-no-downlo.title: Add Streaming Rich Media Video with Download Disabled
add-streaming-rich-media-video-no-downlo.description: Demonstrates how to embed a RichMediaAnnotation that streams an online video into a PDF and configures the annotation to prevent the video from being downloaded.

create-3d-annotation-with-texture-and-ma.title: Create 3D Annotation with Texture and Material in PDF
create-3d-annotation-with-texture-and-ma.description: Demonstrates adding a 3‑D annotation to a PDF, embedding a texture into the 3‑D stream, and configuring material properties for realistic rendering.

button-annotation-calc-sum.title: Create Button Annotation with JavaScript to Sum Two Fields
button-annotation-calc-sum.description: Shows how to add text fields and a button to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and attach JavaScript to the button that calculates and displays the sum of two numeric fields.

add-rotated-semi-transparent-png-waterma.title: Add Rotated Semi-Transparent PNG Watermark to PDF
add-rotated-semi-transparent-png-waterma.description: Loads a PDF, creates an ImageStamp from a PNG logo, sets its size, opacity, and rotation, centers it on the first page, and saves the document with the watermark applied.

add-button-calc-total-pdf.title: Create PDF Button Annotation with JavaScript to Sum Form Fields
add-button-calc-total-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a button field to a PDF, attach a JavaScript action that sums numeric form fields, and write the result to another field using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v3.title: Export Page Annotations to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to export annotations from a specific PDF page to an XFDF file and save it next to the original PDF.

import-annotations-from-fdf__v2.title: Import FDF Annotations into PDF Pages
import-annotations-from-fdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to read a simple FDF file, parse annotation data, and add text annotations to the corresponding PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.

import-annotations-from-fdf__v3.title: Import Annotations and Form Fields from FDF into PDF
import-annotations-from-fdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to read a simple FDF file, import form‑field values and page‑level annotations, and assign them to the correct pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-polyline-figure-annotation__v2.title: Add Polyline Annotation to PDF
add-polyline-figure-annotation__v2.description: Demonstrates creating a polyline annotation from a list of points, calculating its bounding rectangle, styling it, and adding it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Popup Annotation with Custom Size and Position
add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to create a TextAnnotation markup and attach a PopupAnnotation with custom width, height, and an offset relative to the markup annotation.

add-bates-numbering-with-prefix__v2.title: Add Bates Numbering Artifact to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-with-prefix__v2.description: Demonstrates how to apply automatic Bates numbering with a custom prefix and six‑digit format to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v2.title: Import XFDF Annotations into a PDF
import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading an XFDF file, converting its annotation data to Aspose.Pdf annotation objects, and adding them to the corresponding pages of an existing PDF while preserving the original layout.

add-rich-media-video-annotation__v2.title: Add Rich Media Video Annotation with Double‑Click Activation
add-rich-media-video-annotation__v2.description: Demonstrates how to embed a video file in a PDF using a RichMediaAnnotation and configure it to start playback only on a double‑click, with reflection for version‑agnostic compatibility.

batch-add-video-screen-annotations__v2.title: Batch Add Video Screen Annotations to PDF Pages
batch-add-video-screen-annotations__v2.description: Shows how to embed a video file as a ScreenAnnotation on every page of a PDF, automatically sizing and centering the annotation rectangle while preserving the video’s aspect ratio.
